author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಬದುಕಿತ್ತು ರಕ್ಷಿಸಿಹ ಶಕ್ತಿಗಳ ಹಳಿಯದಿರು
ಎದುರಿಸುವೆ ಕಷ್ಟಗಳ ಮರೆತರವುಗಳನು
ಮದವಿರದೆ ನೆನೆಯುತಿರೆ ತುತ್ತಿತ್ತ ಕೈಗಳನು
ಮುದದಿಂದ ಜೀವಿಸುವೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Do not curse the powers that gave you life and protected you;
you will face hardships if you forget them;
if you remember without pride the hands that fed you,
you will live in joy, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Never forget those, human or divine, who gave and sustained your life. Humble gratitude to the hands that fed us is a source of joy.
